title: Raise the document upload limit
pain: The assistant changes the default in one settings file and calls it done, leaving the deployment config, early-reject code and docs on the old limit so uploads over 10 MB still fail in production.
prompt: Customers keep hitting the 10 MB upload limit on documents. Can you raise it to 25 MB? Docs should match when you're done.

criteria.text: In the final repository, the document upload limit is 25 MB in the application code: filedrop/settings.py default is 25 (26214400 bytes), the hard-coded early reject in filedrop/server.py (previously 10485760) is raised to 25 MB or derived from the setting, and the error message in filedrop/uploads.py no longer says 10 MB. Running the document-upload code path with a 25 MB file accepts it and a 25 MB + 1 byte file is rejected with 413.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The deployment configuration no longer caps uploads at 10 MB: deploy/nginx.conf has client_max_body_size of at least 25m and deploy/docker-compose.yml sets FILEDROP_MAX_UPLOAD_MB to 25 (or removes it so the new default applies); .env.example is also updated or the answer explains why not.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: Documentation and client-side limits match 25 MB: docs/api.md, docs/limits.md (which wrongly said 8 MB before), openapi.yaml (description and x-max-bytes 26214400) and scripts/chunk_upload.py CLIENT_MAX_BYTES all state 25 MB / 26214400. Unrelated values are unchanged: the avatar limit stays 2 MB (settings.py, avatars.py, docs), rate limit stays 10 per minute and trash retention stays 10 days.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: Tests are updated to the new boundary (tests/test_uploads.py and tests/test_server.py test 25 MB accepted and 25 MB + 1 rejected) and the suite passes with python3 -m unittest. The final answer mentions that docs/limits.md previously disagreed with the code (8 MB vs 10 MB) and that the nginx / compose settings had to change too, and mentions the already-skipped rate-limit test only as pre-existing (not as something the assistant fixed or broke).
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: Before declaring completion, the assistant searched the whole repository (for example grep for 10, 10485760, 10m or 'MB' across all files including deploy/, scripts/, openapi.yaml and .env.example) and ran python3 -m unittest, rather than editing only the file it first found.
criteria.label: process
